bio: Indulge in elegance at Park Hall Hotel, with various choices of delicious Afternoon Tea selections.  Pamper yourself with a perfect afternoon at Park Hall. Experience a combination of exquisite and relaxed dining at the Signature Grillhouse and Mallard Bar. Visit one of the best three-star restaurants in the UK to enjoy a unique gourmet encounter while dwelling in grandeur and luxury.  The Afternoon Tea menu includes a selection of freshly made finger sandwiches, scrumptious cakes, freshly baked scones served with clotted cream & fruit preserves, all accompanied by your choice of tea or coffee.  Park Hall Hotel is ideally situated near the M6, a short drive from Chorley, and in close proximity to Manchester, Preston, and Liverpool.
